hooks.command: terminal-notifier -title 'Claude Code' -message 'Claude 需要您的操作权限' -sound Crystal
terminal-notifier -title 'Claude Code' -message '任务已完成，等待输入'

FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); FILE_LOWER=$(echo "$FILE" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'); case "$FILE_LOWER" in *.png|*.jpg|*.jpeg|*.gif|*.webp|*.bmp|*.ico) echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"allow\",\"updatedInput\":{\"tool_name\":\"mcp__vision-mcp__summarize_image\",\"tool_input\":{\"image_url\":\"file://${FILE}\"}}}}\" ;; *) echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"allow\"}}\" ;; esac

CMD=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo " $CMD " | grep -qE 'rm\s+(-[a-zA-Z]*r[a-zA-Z]*f|-rf|-fr)\b'; then echo "BLOCKED: rm -rf commands are not allowed. Use 'trash' or 'mv ~/.Trash/' instead." >&2; exit 2; fi; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'
